subject: Novacare off-ramp & staged usage protections — exec approval request
messages:
From: Tim Bauer <tim.bauer@novacare.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Summers <rachel@novacare.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial SOW and ramp — request for off-ramp flexibility

Kim — thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are excited to move forward, but a couple of items are blockers for our procurement and legal team:

1) Usage unpredictability: our teams are piloting two product lines in parallel and we expect asymmetric usage over months 2–6. We need a staged ramp but also a clean opt-out if one product never reaches expected adoption.
2) Downsell protections: because our internal approvals require us to carve out a path to reduce committed spend without onerous penalties, we need language that allows a one-step downsell with a predictable credit schedule.
3) Pricing: to help accelerate signature we asked Sales for a 20% first-year credit applied as a committed discount while we evaluate.

Attached is an updated SOW and a brief note from our legal team. Can Redwood provide sample contract language for: a) staged ramp schedule (monthly check-ins and usage baselines), b) opt-out window (one-time right within first 90 days?), and c) downsell credit schedule tied to notice and usage trailing 30 days?

We need answers by next Wednesday to keep our board timeline.

Attachments: Novacare_SOW_v3.pdf (attached), Novacare_RiskNote.docx (attached)

Thanks,
Tim Bauer
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novacare, Inc.
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Novacare off-ramp request — need deal desk + exec input

Team — forwarding Novacare's ask (below). They want a pretty flexible set of off-ramp/downsell protections and are asking for a 20% first-year credit. I want to flag this for executive sign-off because the proposed language affects revenue recognition and our default ramp policy.

High level risks/considerations:
- If we allow a 90-day unilateral opt-out without escrowed credits, we set a precedent for early releases that inflates churn risk.
- A 20% up-front credit plus staged downsell protection could materially reduce TCV; need finance to run the numbers.
- Legal will want concrete definitions: baseline usage, trailing windows, notice requirements, and how credits are calculated/refunded.

Requesting:
1) Aditya: propose a mutual action plan and suggested contract language for the SOW/Schedule (including staged ramp milestones).
2) Marissa: please run deal desk analysis and confirm whether a partial-credit structure is acceptable; include recovery mechanisms (usage floors, minimums).
3) Vivek: need executive guidance on discount cap and whether we will allow a one-time opt-out in the first 90 days.
4) Monica (Finance): noise on revenue impact and if we need escrowed credits or deferred revenue handling.

Goal: get a proposal we can send to Novacare by EOD Monday (09/06). If you need me to route for exec approval, I will.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Sales (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Novacare off-ramp request — proposed MAP & contract language

Kim — see proposed mutual action plan and redline suggestions below. I took care to preserve our commercial protection while giving Novacare the runway they asked for.

Proposed commercial framework (summary):
- Intro credit: 15% one-time committed credit applied to first invoice (reduces headline discount exposure).
- Staged ramp: 3-month staged ramp (Month 1: 25% commitment, Month 2: 60%, Month 3+: full committed baseline) with monthly check-ins and shared usage dashboards.
- Opt-out: One-time opt-out permitted within the first 60 days (not 90) with 30 days' notice; opt-out triggers pro-rata credit for unused committed capacity, calculated on trailing 30 days of usage and capped at 50% of remaining committed value.
- Downsell rights: After month 6, customer may request a single downsell (max step-down 30% of committed capacity) with 60 days' notice. Any downsell reduces committed minimums prospectively only.
- Early termination: If customer terminates after opt-out window, no refund beyond pro-rata for unused prepaid credits; if termination is within opt-out and meets notice, pro-rata credit applies as above.

Suggested contract language (short form):
"Customer shall have a one-time right to opt-out within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date by providing thirty (30) days' written notice. If Customer exercises the opt-out right, Redwood will apply a pro-rata credit based on average daily usage over the trailing thirty (30) days prior to notice, subject to a cap equal to fifty percent (50%) of remaining committed spend under the Agreement."

Attachments: redwood_ramp_matrix.xlsx (staged ramp & credit calc), SOW redline stub.

Ask: Marissa/Monica — please confirm commercial acceptability. Vivek — recommend we cap intro credit at 15% and allow the 60/30 opt-out structure to balance risk. If approved, I will send this as a formal amendment + MAP to Novacare and prep DocuSign.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 09:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Novacare off-ramp request — executive decision

Thanks for the clear framing. I support a compromise that enables deal velocity while protecting our revenue and precedent. Conditions for executive approval: 

1) Intro credit must be capped at 15% (no exceptions).
2) Opt-out window limited to 60 days with 30 days' notice; approval contingent on inclusion of the 50% cap on remaining committed value as Aditya proposed.
3) All credits tied to documented usage (shared dashboard) and pro-rated per trailing 30-day average; Finance to sign off on accounting treatment (Monica).
4) Downsell allowed only once and maximum 30% reduction; any further reductions require formal renewal or amendment and go through Deal Desk.
5) Require escrowed credit mechanism or holdback in billing (Sales Ops to implement) so we do not post immediate revenue impact without corresponding usage.

Marissa/Monica: confirm we can operationalize the holdback/escrow and that this does not create GAAP complications. If Finance confirms, I authorize Kim to finalize with Novacare on these terms.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Novacare Legal <legal@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Novacare off-ramp request — approved terms and next steps

Tim/Rachel — thanks for the patience. Executive approval granted on the following conditional terms: 

- Introductory credit: 15% one-time credit applied to first invoice.
- Staged ramp: 3-month ramp (Month 1: 25%, Month 2: 60%, Month 3+: full baseline) with monthly check-ins and shared usage dashboard.
- Opt-out: One-time opt-out within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date with thirty (30) days' notice. Opt-out credit will be pro-rated based on the trailing 30-day average usage and capped at fifty percent (50%) of the remaining committed value.
- Downsell: Single downsell allowed after month six, up to 30% reduction prospectively with sixty (60) days' notice.
- Accounting/ops: Finance will apply a holdback/escrow mechanism for the intro credit pending usage verification; Sales Ops will configure billing holds.

Next steps:
1) Aditya: I accepted Vivek's conditions — please finalize the redline amendment and the MAP.
2) Aditya/Marissa: circulate the amended SOW and the redline (attached) to Novacare Legal for review.
3) Monica: confirm accounting entry; copy HubSpot deal (link below).
4) Once legal signs off, we'll route the amendment through DocuSign. Expected turnaround: 3–5 business days.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654/ND-2027-1234

Thanks and looking forward to next steps.

Best,
